name: Goat Cheese-Spinach Linguini with Roasted Acorn Squash & Red Onion

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and halve each acorn squash lengthwise; trim ends, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips. Add to the baking sheet with the squash.
Peel and thinly slice garlic. Add to the baking sheet along with oil, maple syrup, and spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp sage, dried
½ tsp cinnamon, ground
salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until squash is starting to soften, about 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once the water is boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
While the pasta is cooking, crumble goat cheese into a small bowl. Set aside.
Wash and dry spinach (skip this step if it came pre-washed). Place spinach in a colander and set aside.

When the squash is starting to soften, remove from the oven. Add pumpkin seeds to the baking sheet, stir to combine, and spread back out in an even layer. Return to the oven and continue to roast until squash is fork-tender and golden, 5-10 minutes more. Remove from oven.

When the pasta is done, reserve a ½-cup of pasta water, then drain over the spinach in the colander. Return pasta, spinach, and reserved pasta water to the pot. Add goat cheese and stir until the pasta is creamy and combined.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls, then top with roasted squash, onion, and pumpkin seeds. Enjoy!
